description: LedgerStore WAL records: the 8-byte little-endian key (handle << 40) | slot, then the body. A slot record has a handle below 2^24 - 1 and the slot's DATA, a non-empty value, as its body; nextHandle is the catalog's next handle. A store record has the store handle, 2^24 - 1, and its kind in the slot field (1 create, 2 drop, 3 seal). A create's body is one or more 16-byte pairs, each a ledger ID (u64), the handle (u32) its replica takes, and the window (u32) of the request which creates it; a drop's body is the ledger ID (u64) it drops, whose replica it removes, if the node holds one, and whose tombstone it records; a seal's body is the ledger ID (u64) and handle (u32) of the replica it seals. Slots and ledger IDs are decimal strings.

cases.name: data
cases.description: DATA at handle 0, slot 0: the key, then the value.

cases.name: one-zero-byte
cases.description: DATA of one zero byte at handle 2, slot 42: any non-empty value is DATA.

cases.name: maximum-key
cases.description: DATA at the last replica handle, 2^24 - 2, and the last slot, 2^40 - 1.

cases.name: create
cases.description: A create of ledger 7 by a request of window 64, which takes handle 0.

cases.name: create-batch
cases.description: A batch of three creations, of ledgers 9, 4, and 12 by requests of windows 4, 64, and 1, taking handles 3, 4, and 5.

cases.name: drop
cases.description: A drop of ledger 7, whose replica the node holds: it removes the replica and records the tombstone.

cases.name: drop-unheld
cases.description: A drop of ledger 12, which the node never held: it records the tombstone all the same.

cases.name: seal
cases.description: A seal of ledger 7's replica at handle 0.

cases.name: create-last-handle
cases.description: A create of the largest ledger ID by a request of the largest window, 2^31 - 1, taking the last replica handle, 2^24 - 2.

cases.name: drop-largest-ledger
cases.description: A drop of the largest ledger ID.

cases.name: seal-last-handle
cases.description: A seal of the largest ledger ID's replica at the last replica handle, 2^24 - 2.
